title: Old Rules in the Stadium
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：may　|　正文 295 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 may 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 nobody in the stadium ① might cross the bridge after dark, and every trainer there remembered the fact for years. Three years on the world had turned over: by then even the youngest trainer ② may cross the bridge after dark without complaint, and nobody troubled to watch. My uncle wrote the change into the programme at once, and read the line aloud once every year thereafter.

The rules, though, were older than either of those worlds. A visitor ③ may not cross the bridge after dark before the September rains; the athlete ④ might not cross the bridge after dark either, and said so plainly to anybody who asked. Nobody in the stadium ever thought of arguing with him about it.

⑤ Might anybody cross the bridge after dark, my uncle wanted to know, without the athlete standing beside them? My mother, who heard every version of the story, said we ⑥ might cross the bridge after dark once the programme was signed and not a day before. Even the oldest trainer agreed with her in the end.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme: the work ⑦ may be mended before the September fair, and nothing was said otherwise. My uncle swore it ⑧ might have been mended long before anybody thought to ask. Might it truly have been mended so early? Nobody there could say.

⑨ In 2000 only one person in the whole stadium might cross the bridge after dark without help, and my mother kept the name in the programme for thirty years. ⑩ Even today a stranger may not cross the bridge after dark without permission, and that, my mother said in 2002, is what the old rule was really about. She repeated the sentence whenever the stadium forgot itself.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. modal. 可能（过去形式 might cross the bridge after dark：1990 年那时候人人如此）
B. modal. 可能（现在形式 may cross the bridge after dark：如今连最小的陪练也毫无怨言地做得到）
C. modal. 可以（许可）（现在形式的否定 may not cross the bridge after dark：规矩不许，如今也仍然如此）
D. modal. 可能（过去形式的否定 might not cross the bridge after dark：那时的运动员也不能这么做）
E. modal. 可能（疑问句 might anybody cross the bridge after dark?：叔叔当年追问的话）
F. modal. 可能（间接引语 she said we might cross the bridge after dark：转述母亲的话）
G. modal. 可能（被动 may be mended：活儿被 mended 才算办妥）
H. modal. 可能（完成式 might have been mended：对早先情形的推断）

items.q: might cross the bridge after dark
may cross the bridge after dark without complaint
may not cross the bridge after dark before
might not cross the bridge after dark
might anybody cross the bridge after dark,
we might cross the bridge after dark once
might cross the bridge after dark without help
may not cross the bridge after dark without permission

answers.why: may 表可能，1990 年体育场里没有一个人天黑后过那座桥，叙述过去的事，故用过去形式 might。
may 表可能，多年之后连最年轻的陪练都毫无怨言地天黑后过那座桥，说现在的情况，用 may。
may 表可以（许可），规矩上说客人不得天黑后过那座桥，否定形式是 may not cross the bridge after dark。
may 表可能，运动员当年也不能这么做，过去形式的否定是 might not cross the bridge after dark。
may 表可能，叔叔追问的是“难道没有人能天黑后过那座桥吗”，疑问句 might anybody cross the bridge after dark?
may 表可能，母亲说的是“簿子签过之后我们才天黑后过那座桥”，间接引语里用 might。
may 表可能，秩序册上那行字是说活儿必须在集前被人 mended，被动形式 may be mended。
may 表可能，叔叔断定活儿老早就被 mended，对过去的推断用 might have been mended。
may 表可能，2000 年只有一个人无人相助也能天黑后过那座桥，用过去形式 might。
may 表可以（许可），母亲 2002 年说，如今生人没有许可仍不得天黑后过那座桥，否定 may not cross the bridge after dark。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，体育场里没有一个人天黑后过那座桥，人人都把这件事记了好多年。（might cross the bridge after dark）
多年以后，连最年轻的陪练都毫无怨言地天黑后过那座桥。（may cross the bridge after dark）
按老规矩，客人在九月雨季之前不得天黑后过那座桥。（may not cross the bridge after dark）
那位运动员当年也不能天黑后过那座桥，谁问他就直说。（might not cross the bridge after dark）
母亲说，簿子签过之后我们才可以天黑后过那座桥，早一天也不行。（she said we might cross the bridge after dark）
叔叔一口咬定，那件活儿早在有人过问之前就被 mended 了。（might have been mended）
